reasoning: The two rectangular looping arrows are universally recognized as repeat, cycle, sync, swap, or repost. Because it is an abstract relational symbol rather than a concrete noun, it fits best when the core point of the task is swapping/exchanging items, syncing data, or setting up recurring cycles, though concrete object icons usually beat it whenever a specific noun is present.

pass1.ambiguity: Closely resembles circular refresh/sync arrows, swap/transfer arrows, and social media repost icons; abstract arrow geometry makes it refer to an action or schedule rather than a concrete object.
